harnessCorrections: Initial Ranger/Mage probes did not turn the camera. Fixed the probe to use normal applyCameraLook, and accept ordinary earned rank-up choices. No gameplay balance adjustment.

Co-op pose test initially compared before interpolation and applied an artificial stun that prevented position correction. Removed the fixture stun and advanced the normal guest update; all 11 checks passed.
limits: Scripted fights read attack states perfectly and pump simulated frames. They prove mechanical feasibility, not novice difficulty, pacing or human victory.
No manual healing/invulnerability during complete fights. Normal earned level-up healing remains active.
Local host/guest message relay does not test Internet latency or two remote devices.
No full-campaign, mobile layout or target-device performance certification. Screenshots are layout checks, not approval of existing character/environment art.
